title: VideoPlaylistReadRequest
description: video.playlist-read-request@1: video.playlist.read takes no body. GET /api/v1/video/playlists (the caller's own), GET /api/v1/video/playlists/:id (the owner sees a private one; anyone a public or unlisted one; otherwise 404 playlist.not_found, never 403) and the open GET /api/v1/video/users/:username/playlists, whose query is { limit?, cursor? } (limit 1-50, default 20; cursor is the previous page's next_cursor; 404 user.not_found).
